notes: RBox delete: transitivity of part_of removed; its other tags kept. "Could X fail to be ...?" is mode consistent on the negative assertion. has_part, its inverse, has no transitivity tag of its own (RELATIONS.md states a property an inverse pair shares on one row only (since 2026-10-30), and reason.py removes it from the pair). A null answer to "Does it follow ...?" means it no longer follows; to "Is it possible ...?", that it is no longer ruled out.
